headline: gortex has NO capability our stack lacks. What it has is CONSOLIDATION - one binary, one store, one daemon, one UI, one install. We hold the same capabilities across three engines, ~1.07GB of indexes and three-plus web UIs, with nothing that lists any of them. The harvest confirms and enlarges workgraph N94: we already built the thing the screenshot made us want, and it is invisible.

capabilities.theirs: 35 node kinds, ~64 edge kinds - internal/graph/node.go + internal/graph/edge.go. Covers HTTP routes, pub/sub topics, ORM tables, docs, contracts, capability edges (env reads, process exec), MinHash clone detection.
capabilities.ours: cmm live on Prism today: 94,184 nodes / 196,191 edges at HEAD, incl. Route label (143 nodes) and HTTP_CALLS/GRPC_CALLS/CONFIGURES edges. gnx: 43,693 symbols / 96,170 relationships / 300 flows. crg: 455MB live index. PLUS a second graph domain gortex has no equivalent of - the project/story workgraph, 804 nodes / 778 edges.

capabilities.theirs: Four surfaces. MCP: 178 tools (internal/mcp/promote_call_gate_test.go:37, docs/mcp-facade-v1.md:57; README's 175 is stale), 18 resources (13 addResource + 5 addResourceTemplate; README's 16 is stale), 3 prompts - but a structurally-enforced 21-tool compact facade (internal/mcp/facade_registry.go:265-477) is what every named client actually receives. HTTP: 20 /v1/* routes + /mcp Streamable-HTTP. CLI. Library: pkg/gortex/api.go, 181 lines, 10 methods, genuinely daemon-free. All clients share ONE AF_UNIX socket including on Windows (internal/daemon/paths.go:43-44) - not a named pipe.

corrections.claim: Extremely fast analysis - a precomputed depth-3 reach index turns blast-radius queries into O(seeds x reach) map lookups
corrections.finding: DESCRIBES DEAD CODE. reach.BuildIndex has ZERO production callers - 45 references, all in _test.go; every production hit is a comment. The eager pass was deliberately retired at internal/indexer/indexer.go ~4150 with their own numbers: on kubernetes/kubernetes ~2000s to build to save ~10ms per query, a ~200,000-query breakeven. Live mechanism is reach.Lookup, lazy per-seed BFS with memoisation.
corrections.honestFraming: The capability exists; the advertised mechanism does not run. Blast radius is still fast, just not fast the way the README says.

contractCompliance.D1: griot-harvest invoked and followed - survey script run unmodified, shelf checked before any web search, one agent per pattern, landing zone grounded by a separate agent.
contractCompliance.D2: Every capability row cites evidence on both sides. The single ABSENT row (embeddable in-process library) records the search that failed.
contractCompliance.D3: All nine axes covered as their own rows - what is indexed, how built/refreshed, where stored, how queried, what it renders, agent integration, performance claims with benchmarks, licence and language, maturity signals.
contractCompliance.D4: The web UI has its own deep section, grounded in the UI SOURCE after cloning gortexhq/web - not in the screenshot. Serving code, stack, data contract, interactions and the liftability split are all cited.
contractCompliance.D5: Nine lifts, each with class, named Griot target, effort in steps, and what it replaces or extends. Studio norm stated: grafting is the norm, adopting is the exception.
contractCompliance.D6: Surface inventory with grouped counts, a port map, two real collisions, a ranked buried list, and an explicit earned coverage caveat.
contractCompliance.D7: READ ONLY upheld. No commits, no pushes, no publishes. Nothing modified in gortex, gortex-web, or any Griot repo. Only the three contract outputs plus gitignored scratch were written. No decision taken that is Gavin's - every one is recorded in openItems.
